name: Agent ID badge
oneLiner: a round portrait pops in above the head on a glass rim, then shrinks into a small role pill while the agent's big name sets in over a tiny italic 'is my'; roster variant stacks three agents with their last message
say: when the speaker introduces an agent, bot or teammate by name ('his name is Jamie, he's my chief of staff'): cut in on the name; use mode roster when they list the whole team of bots
